scope: Prospective metadata-only original-query-anchored physical cue AUX inventory; not training admission
rule: Keep all960 original rows/q/L/folds. Entire strictly-positive native bilinear stencil of all four RGB96 centre samples must lie inside exactly one known FULL certified cue group; no other located group may touch it. Unlocated potential competitors/unknown or contradictory candidate-group state yield U. Only existing certified duplicate groups may dedup. No shrink/recenter or model-outcome filtering.
central_samples: q+(sx*L/192,sy*L/192), sx/sy in {-1,+1}; FP64 bilinear weights, native cells with weight>0 exactly, zero-weight neighbours excluded; all cells inside native canvas required.

raster.PALLOX: Existing V95 prospective closed physical-uncertainty convention: floor(lo+.5) through floor(hi+.5), inclusive; original coordinates unchanged. Source V91 field name contains half_open; this record explicitly states the native-raster convention used here.
raster.LOCO: Original V3 half-open pixel-edge support UNION uncertainty, floor(lo+.5):ceil(hi+.5).

candidate: Pallox candidate mask unions known FULL records within one existing certified group; no new coordinate merge/mean. Candidate group must have one consistent known state with no unknown member. PARTIAL-only is not a known candidate. Distinct located PARTIAL or U touching footprint competes. Any null/unlocated cue group cannot be spatially excluded and yields U.
LOCO_scope: Only the same-query root decision may supply its known D single-cue support. Other root query-U records are unannotated query decisions, not an exhaustive set of unlocated physical cues; no label borrowing between queries or NO/UNKNOWN->E conversion.
